////////  Synth-C

The result collection of expermiments
-  a camera following a path
-  cyclic megabufs
-  running (?) average sound values, with help from El-Vis
-  dm-scc syncing
-  a huge control scope

-  controls
   - press shift to toggle control mode
   - left slider adjusts n of the path texer
   - right slider adjusts camera speed





You may use any part of this preset under the condition that you include credits,contact information (synth_c@hotmail.com), and my site (www.synth-c.deviantart.com), and do not copy the entire preset.
You may remix this preset without my permission if you include this comment in it, and let me now where to get it.
